create_RGB2YUV: create an RGB2YUV nn.Module to convert batched RGB tensors to YUV color space
create_YUV2RGB: create a YUV2RGB nn.Module to convert batched YUV tensors back to RGB color space
run_rgb_to_yuv: run the rgb_to_yuv function to convert a batched RGB image tensor to YUV
run_yuv_to_rgb: run the yuv_to_rgb function to convert a batched YUV image tensor to RGB
build_get_transforms: build train and val transforms with color jitter and random flip for a given image size
